Signals.Name: VersionMajor
Signals.Summary: App Major Version number.

Signals.Name: VersionMinor
Signals.Summary: App Minor Version number.

Signals.Name: VersionBugfix
Signals.Summary: App Bugfix Version number.

Signals.Name: VersionBuild
Signals.Summary: App Build Version number.

Signals.Name: Version
Signals.Summary: Full Version of firmware in device.  The format is a four byte value.

Signals.Name: FaultField
Signals.Summary: Integer representing all fault flags reported by the device.

Signals.Name: StickyFaultField
Signals.Summary: Integer representing all (persistent) sticky fault flags reported by the device.

Signals.Name: MotorVoltage
Signals.Summary: The applied (output) motor voltage.

Signals.Name: ForwardLimit
Signals.Summary: Forward Limit Pin.

Signals.Name: ReverseLimit
Signals.Summary: Reverse Limit Pin.

Signals.Name: AppliedRotorPolarity
Signals.Summary: The applied rotor polarity as seen from the front of the motor.  This typically is determined by the Inverted config, but can be overridden if using Follower features.

Signals.Name: DutyCycle
Signals.Summary: The applied motor duty cycle.

Signals.Name: TorqueCurrent
Signals.Summary: Current corresponding to the torque output by the motor. Similar to StatorCurrent. Users will likely prefer this current to calculate the applied torque to the rotor.

Signals.Name: StatorCurrent
Signals.Summary: Current corresponding to the stator windings. Similar to TorqueCurrent. Users will likely prefer TorqueCurrent over StatorCurrent.

Signals.Name: SupplyCurrent
Signals.Summary: Measured supply side current.

Signals.Name: SupplyVoltage
Signals.Summary: Measured supply voltage to the device.

Signals.Name: DeviceTemp
Signals.Summary: Temperature of device.

Signals.Name: ProcessorTemp
Signals.Summary: Temperature of the processor.

Signals.Name: RotorVelocity
Signals.Summary: Velocity of the motor rotor. This velocity is not affected by any feedback configs.

Signals.Name: RotorPosition
Signals.Summary: Position of the motor rotor. This position is only affected by the RotorOffset config and calls to setPosition.

Signals.Name: Velocity
Signals.Summary: Velocity of the device in mechanism rotations per second. This can be the velocity of a remote sensor and is affected by the RotorToSensorRatio and SensorToMechanismRatio configs.

Signals.Name: Position
Signals.Summary: Position of the device in mechanism rotations. This can be the position of a remote sensor and is affected by the RotorToSensorRatio and SensorToMechanismRatio configs, as well as calls to setPosition.

Signals.Name: Acceleration
Signals.Summary: Acceleration of the device in mechanism rotations per second². This can be the acceleration of a remote sensor and is affected by the RotorToSensorRatio and SensorToMechanismRatio configs.

Signals.Name: ControlMode
Signals.Summary: The active control mode of the motor controller.

Signals.Name: MotionMagicAtTarget
Signals.Summary: Check if the Motion Magic® profile has reached the target. This is equivalent to checking that MotionMagicIsRunning, the ClosedLoopReference is the target, and the ClosedLoopReferenceSlope is 0.

Signals.Name: MotionMagicIsRunning
Signals.Summary: Check if Motion Magic® is running.  This is equivalent to checking that the reported control mode is a Motion Magic® based mode.

Signals.Name: RobotEnable
Signals.Summary: Indicates if the robot is enabled.

Signals.Name: DeviceEnable
Signals.Summary: Indicates if device is actuator enabled.

Signals.Name: ClosedLoopSlot
Signals.Summary: The slot that the closed-loop PID is using.

Signals.Name: MotorOutputStatus
Signals.Summary: Assess the status of the motor output with respect to load and supply.

Signals.Name: DifferentialControlMode
Signals.Summary: The active control mode of the differential controller.

Signals.Name: DifferentialAverageVelocity
Signals.Summary: Average component of the differential velocity of device.

Signals.Name: DifferentialAveragePosition
Signals.Summary: Average component of the differential position of device.

Signals.Name: DifferentialDifferenceVelocity
Signals.Summary: Difference component of the differential velocity of device.

Signals.Name: DifferentialDifferencePosition
Signals.Summary: Difference component of the differential position of device.

Signals.Name: DifferentialClosedLoopSlot
Signals.Summary: The slot that the closed-loop differential PID is using.

Signals.Name: MotorKT
Signals.Summary: The torque constant (K_T) of the motor.

Signals.Name: MotorKV
Signals.Summary: The velocity constant (K_V) of the motor.

Signals.Name: MotorStallCurrent
Signals.Summary: The stall current of the motor at 12 V output.

Signals.Name: BridgeOutput
Signals.Summary: The applied output of the bridge.

Signals.Name: IsProLicensed
Signals.Summary: Whether the device is Phoenix Pro licensed.

Signals.Name: AncillaryDeviceTemp
Signals.Summary: Temperature of device from second sensor.

Signals.Name: ConnectedMotor
Signals.Summary: The type of motor attached to the Talon.

Signals.Name: Fault_Hardware
Signals.Summary: Hardware fault occurred

Signals.Name: StickyFault_Hardware
Signals.Summary: Hardware fault occurred

Signals.Name: Fault_ProcTemp
Signals.Summary: Processor temperature exceeded limit

Signals.Name: StickyFault_ProcTemp
Signals.Summary: Processor temperature exceeded limit

Signals.Name: Fault_DeviceTemp
Signals.Summary: Device temperature exceeded limit

Signals.Name: StickyFault_DeviceTemp
Signals.Summary: Device temperature exceeded limit

Signals.Name: Fault_Undervoltage
Signals.Summary: Device supply voltage dropped to near brownout levels

Signals.Name: StickyFault_Undervoltage
Signals.Summary: Device supply voltage dropped to near brownout levels

Signals.Name: Fault_BootDuringEnable
Signals.Summary: Device boot while detecting the enable signal

Signals.Name: StickyFault_BootDuringEnable
Signals.Summary: Device boot while detecting the enable signal

Signals.Name: Fault_UnlicensedFeatureInUse
Signals.Summary: An unlicensed feature is in use, device may not behave as expected.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_UnlicensedFeatureInUse
Signals.Summary: An unlicensed feature is in use, device may not behave as expected.

Signals.Name: Fault_BridgeBrownout
Signals.Summary: Bridge was disabled most likely due to supply voltage dropping too low.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_BridgeBrownout
Signals.Summary: Bridge was disabled most likely due to supply voltage dropping too low.

Signals.Name: Fault_RemoteSensorReset
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor has reset.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_RemoteSensorReset
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor has reset.

Signals.Name: Fault_MissingDifferentialFX
Signals.Summary: The remote Talon used for differential control is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_MissingDifferentialFX
Signals.Summary: The remote Talon used for differential control is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: Fault_RemoteSensorPosOverflow
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor position has overflowed. Because of the nature of remote sensors, it is possible for the remote sensor position to overflow beyond what is supported by the status signal frame. However, this is rare and cannot occur over the course of an FRC match under normal use.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_RemoteSensorPosOverflow
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor position has overflowed. Because of the nature of remote sensors, it is possible for the remote sensor position to overflow beyond what is supported by the status signal frame. However, this is rare and cannot occur over the course of an FRC match under normal use.

Signals.Name: Fault_OverSupplyV
Signals.Summary: Supply Voltage has exceeded the maximum voltage rating of device.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_OverSupplyV
Signals.Summary: Supply Voltage has exceeded the maximum voltage rating of device.

Signals.Name: Fault_UnstableSupplyV
Signals.Summary: Supply Voltage is unstable.  Ensure you are using a battery and current limited power supply.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_UnstableSupplyV
Signals.Summary: Supply Voltage is unstable.  Ensure you are using a battery and current limited power supply.

Signals.Name: Fault_ReverseHardLimit
Signals.Summary: Reverse limit switch has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_ReverseHardLimit
Signals.Summary: Reverse limit switch has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: Fault_ForwardHardLimit
Signals.Summary: Forward limit switch has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_ForwardHardLimit
Signals.Summary: Forward limit switch has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: Fault_ReverseSoftLimit
Signals.Summary: Reverse soft limit has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_ReverseSoftLimit
Signals.Summary: Reverse soft limit has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: Fault_ForwardSoftLimit
Signals.Summary: Forward soft limit has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_ForwardSoftLimit
Signals.Summary: Forward soft limit has been asserted.  Output is set to neutral.

Signals.Name: Fault_MissingSoftLimitRemote
Signals.Summary: The remote soft limit device is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_MissingSoftLimitRemote
Signals.Summary: The remote soft limit device is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: Fault_MissingHardLimitRemote
Signals.Summary: The remote limit switch device is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_MissingHardLimitRemote
Signals.Summary: The remote limit switch device is not present on CAN Bus.

Signals.Name: Fault_RemoteSensorDataInvalid
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor's data is no longer trusted. This can happen if the remote sensor disappears from the CAN bus or if the remote sensor indicates its data is no longer valid, such as when a CANcoder's magnet strength falls into the "red" range.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_RemoteSensorDataInvalid
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor's data is no longer trusted. This can happen if the remote sensor disappears from the CAN bus or if the remote sensor indicates its data is no longer valid, such as when a CANcoder's magnet strength falls into the "red" range.

Signals.Name: Fault_FusedSensorOutOfSync
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor used for fusion has fallen out of sync to the local sensor. A re-synchronization has occurred, which may cause a discontinuity. This typically happens if there is significant slop in the mechanism, or if the RotorToSensorRatio configuration parameter is incorrect.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_FusedSensorOutOfSync
Signals.Summary: The remote sensor used for fusion has fallen out of sync to the local sensor. A re-synchronization has occurred, which may cause a discontinuity. This typically happens if there is significant slop in the mechanism, or if the RotorToSensorRatio configuration parameter is incorrect.

Signals.Name: Fault_StatorCurrLimit
Signals.Summary: Stator current limit occured.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_StatorCurrLimit
Signals.Summary: Stator current limit occured.

Signals.Name: Fault_SupplyCurrLimit
Signals.Summary: Supply current limit occured.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_SupplyCurrLimit
Signals.Summary: Supply current limit occured.

Signals.Name: Fault_UsingFusedCANcoderWhileUnlicensed
Signals.Summary: Using Fused CANcoder feature while unlicensed. Device has fallen back to remote CANcoder.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_UsingFusedCANcoderWhileUnlicensed
Signals.Summary: Using Fused CANcoder feature while unlicensed. Device has fallen back to remote CANcoder.

Signals.Name: Fault_StaticBrakeDisabled
Signals.Summary: Static brake was momentarily disabled due to excessive braking current while disabled.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_StaticBrakeDisabled
Signals.Summary: Static brake was momentarily disabled due to excessive braking current while disabled.

Signals.Name: Fault_RotorFault1
Signals.Summary: Trips if a major mechanical or ESD event caused a brief loss of position data triggering a recovery while not in motion. If the event occurs often, inspect for excess axial force or sources of ESD at the rotor.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_RotorFault1
Signals.Summary: Trips if a major mechanical or ESD event caused a brief loss of position data triggering a recovery while not in motion. If the event occurs often, inspect for excess axial force or sources of ESD at the rotor.

Signals.Name: Fault_RotorFault2
Signals.Summary: Trips if a major mechanical or ESD event caused a brief loss of position data triggering a recovery while in motion. If the event occurs often, inspect for excess axial force or sources of ESD at the rotor.

Signals.Name: StickyFault_RotorFault2
Signals.Summary: Trips if a major mechanical or ESD event caused a brief loss of position data triggering a recovery while in motion. If the event occurs often, inspect for excess axial force or sources of ESD at the rotor.
